data.verdict: GROUNDED: (1) bwS0=d_q/D is exactly the compact SU_q(2)/Hecke quantum-dimension vector — 3 balanced q-integers [1],[4],[5] (Laurent polynomials) + the product [4][3]/[2]; = Verlinde S_{0λ}/S_{00}. (2) The uploaded Murakami paper (GPPV proof) has no colored/decorated block; its Σ(2,3,5) block is the undecorated D=2 false theta (golden, refuted). Consequence: the non-compact q-Bessel search (redirect ii) targets a transcendental function class to hit a compact-algebraic target; the single-argument (falsifiable) form is refuted (qbessel-gate §4) and the multi-argument form is an unfalsifiable ≥4-dof fit without the (un-uploaded) Koelink–Swarttouw Plancherel kernel. The honest resolution is redirect (iii): the compact Verlinde/Hecke identity S_{0λ}/S_{00}=d_q (BWVacuumRowIsHecke), near-definitional. Scope (a) on the tested q-Bessel forms; no structural exclusion of a Plancherel-fixed row asserted.
